* Function:    H5F__cache_superblock_get_initial_load_size
 *
 * Purpose:     Return the initial load size for the superblock
 *
 * Return:      Success:        SUCCEED
 *              Failure:        FAIL
 *
 * Programmer:  Quincey Koziol
 *              July 18 2013
 *
 *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 */
static herr_t
H5F__cache_superblock_get_initial_load_size(void H5_ATTR_UNUSED *udata, size_t *image_len)
{
    FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE_NOERR

    /* Set the initial image size */
    *image_len = H5F_SUPERBLOCK_FIXED_SIZE + H5F_SUPERBLOCK_MINIMAL_VARLEN_SIZE;

    FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(SUCCEED)
} /* end H5F__cache_superblock_get_initial_load_size() */

/*-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * Function:    H5F__cache_superblock_get_final_load_size
 *
 * Purpose:     Return the final load size for the superblock
 *
 * Return:      Success:        SUCCEED
 *              Failure:        FAIL
 *
 * Programmer:  Quincey Koziol
 *              July 18 2013
 *
 *-------------------------------------------------------------------------
 */
static herr_t
H5F__cache_superblock_get_final_load_size(const void *_image, size_t image_len, void *_udata, size_t *actual_len)
{
    const uint8_t             *image = (const uint8_t *)_image; /* Pointer into raw data buffer */
    H5F_superblock_cache_ud_t *udata = (H5F_superblock_cache_ud_t *)_udata; /* User data */
    size_t                     ret_value = SUCCEED; /* Return value */

    FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE_NOERR

    /* Check arguments */
    HDassert(image);
    HDassert(actual_len);

    /* Sanity check */
    HDassert(image_len >= H5F_SUPERBLOCK_FIXED_SIZE + H5F_SUPERBLOCK_MINIMAL_VARLEN_SIZE);

    /* Set the final image size */
    *actual_len = H5F_SUPERBLOCK_FIXED_SIZE + H5F_SUPERBLOCK_VARLEN_SIZE(image[H5F_OFFSET_SUPERBLOCK_VERSION],
                                                                        image[H5F_OFFSET_SUPERBLOCK_ADDR_SIZE],
                                                                        image[H5F_OFFSET_SUPERBLOCK_SIZE_SIZE]);

    FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
} /* end H5F__cache_superblock_get_final_load_size() */
